task: Create a new Excel file named contact_images.xlsx with a single column labeled 'Filename'. List all contact image filenames from the /testbed/data directory (John_card.jpg, Bob_card.png, Tom_card.png) under this column in alphabetical order. Then, send an email to Tom with the subject 'Contact Image Files' containing a brief note and listing the three filenames in the email body.
query_sentence: Summarize the contact image files in an Excel sheet and notify Tom with the file names via email.

ground_truth_memory.info: The contact image filenames are John_card.jpg, Bob_card.png, and Tom_card.png.
Create a new Excel file named contact_images.xlsx.
The first column in the Excel file should be labeled 'Filename'.
List the image filenames in alphabetical order in the Excel file.
Send an email to Tom with the subject 'Contact Image Files'.
Include a list of the three image filenames in the email body.
Bob is the sender of the email to Tom regarding contact images.
